caseName: Carolina, Clinchfield & Ohio Railway v. Stroup
caseNameFull: Carolina, Clinchfield & Ohio Railway, in Error v. George W. Stroup
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. John W. Price for plaintiff in error., Mr. Robert Burrow and Mr. Isaac Harr for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 3 of the Act of Congress of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726, 727.
